headline: Trevor Noah is hosting Google’s Pixel 11 launch event
summary: Trevor Noah will host Google's upcoming Pixel 11 launch event. The "Made by Google" hardware event is scheduled for August 12th. Other celebrities and influencers are also expected to participate.

headline: Jony Ive's first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey puck-sized smart speaker
summary: Jony Ive and OpenAI are developing a battery-powered, doughnut-shaped smart speaker. The device is rumored to be hockey puck-sized and without a display. Expected to launch in 2027 with a price over $300.

headline: The AirPods Pro are $60 off, their best price since late June
summary: AirPods Pro are currently on sale for $189.99, a $60 discount. This marks their lowest price since late June's Prime Day sales. Deals are available at Best Buy, Amazon, and Walmart.

headline: The Zelda movie’s Ganondorf casting hints at more movies
summary: Uli Latukefu has been cast as Ganondorf in the upcoming Zelda movie. Latukefu reportedly signed a multi-picture deal, hinting at sequels. Nintendo and Sony have not formally confirmed multiple films yet.

headline: The First Fourth Wing Graphic Novel Is Up for Preorder on Amazon, Out April 2027
summary: The first "Fourth Wing" graphic novel is now available for preorder. It is listed on Amazon with an anticipated release date of April 2027. Fans can secure their copy of the highly anticipated adaptation.

headline: American Squid Game Spinoff Series Reportedly Canceled at Netflix
summary: Netflix has reportedly shelved David Fincher's American "Squid Game" spinoff. Sources close to the project confirm its cancellation. The series was an anticipated adaptation of the hit Korean show.

headline: Quake Gets Free New Campaign Co-Developed by MachineGames for Game's 30th Anniversary
summary: A new 19-level campaign has been added to the 2021 Quake remaster. The campaign was co-developed by MachineGames. It celebrates the classic FPS game's 30th anniversary.

headline: Call of Duty: World at War Multiplayer Nearly Had a Much Larger Focus on Vehicles
summary: Dataminers found content suggesting more vehicle focus in CoD: World at War multiplayer. Early development might have included more extensive vehicle combat. This unearths a previously unseen aspect of the game's design.

headline: Thousands of rail passengers hit by power failure disruption
summary: A major power outage in Manchester caused widespread rail disruption. Thousands of passengers experienced delays and cancellations. Services are expected to be affected throughout the evening.

headline: Uefa says boycott may still go ahead as FA withdraws Infantino support
summary: Uefa maintains that a boycott against Fifa's Gianni Infantino is still possible. The FA has withdrawn its support for the Fifa president. Uefa states Fifa's backing of Infantino "changes nothing."

headline: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
summary: Meta has been fined $567 million in a landmark child safety ruling. A New Mexico judge imposed the penalty over harm to children. This is the largest child safety fine against a social media company.

headline: Arrests in Norfolk town as disorder continues for third night
summary: Arrests have been made in a Norfolk market town amid ongoing disorder. The unrest is linked to anti-immigration protests. This marks the third consecutive night of disturbances in the area.
